text:
Ivy: quick check  slow Saturday plan: pancake crawl downtown at 10am or quick Ridge trail run at 8am? vote with emoji :pancakes: :runner:

Samir: pancakes for me. can never say no to maple. also slow day sounds right.

Noelle: trail run if someone can spot me a coffee afterward. im indecisive.

Ethan: i'm team trail. short loop, 6km, easy pace. early finish leaves the rest of the day free.

Ivy: Ridge Loop 08:00 meets at Quarry Lot. pancake crawl 10:00 meet at Maple Alley Diner. both sound good.

kudos-bot: shoutout to Noelle for organizing last week's board games night :trophy:

Noelle: thanks! also if pancakes, i can bring a frisbee for the park after.

Samir: weather check? don't want to soggy-run or soggy-pancake.

weather-bot: Saturday 07:30  Ridge Loop: 60% clear, Temp 10°C / 50°F. Sunday 10:00  Downtown: 0-10% rain, Temp 18°C / 64°F. Good for pancakes.

Ethan: ok trail it is. who wants a shorter option? i can do the 3.5km out-and-back as an alt.

Ivy: shorter option noted for anyone not feeling 6km. plan: Ridge Loop 08:00 Quarry Lot. pancakes at Maple Alley 10:30 for everyone who wants to join after.

Samir: i'll join pancakes only (sleeping in champ). list me as pancake backup.

Noelle: i'll come to pancakes after games setup. tagging a calendar invite to keep it tidy. ```/calendar create "Ridge Run + Pancakes" Sat 08:00 Quarry Lot```

calendar-bot: Event created: "Ridge Run + Pancakes" Sat 08:00  Invited: Ivy, Samir, Noelle, Ethan.

Ethan: will bring spare running belt and a couple of energy gels. also mandatory sunrise photo for the slack channel. :camera_with_flash:

Ivy: perfect. i'll post the short GPX route for the loop tonight. see you bright and early runners. pancakes for the rest of you! :pancakes:
